purpose: Work file: an audit of what could be simpler in the code, done 16/11/2026 (built).
details: Lists the six unused definitions that were removed, the CLAUDE.md shortening (304 to about 110 lines, details to docs/architectuur.md), the audit findings with recommendations (duplicate tip code in zinsdelen/werkwoord, three places to register an input object, an always-empty BINNENKORT, an unused onregelmatig key, plan.md length), the phases (A: StappenHulp and the two attributes on input objects; B: leerlijn keys and plan.md) and what turned out differently.
summary: Cleanup audit: six dead definitions removed (verified by running the suite without them), CLAUDE.md shortened, findings with recommendations (shared tip code → terminal/stappenhulp.py, input objects declare geen_tweede_kans and vraag_is_zin, leave CU.BINNENKORT, remove unused onregelmatig keys, shorten plan.md), things that look dead but are not (getattr(self, '_' + soort) in vraagstukken), the phases, and deviations.
